basic_info.description: This Inner-Mission Victorian home is poised for your creative touch, offering the chance to restore its traditional allure or infuse it with modern flair. Stripped to the studs, it presents a blank canvas for transformation. Beneath lies a full-floor, unfinished basement, ripe for potential expansion. The substantial backyard beckons as the ideal spot for crafting a personal retreat. Its walkable location, close to shopping, cafes, and transit, plus convenient freeway access, makes this an excellent prospect for a substantial project in the Inner Mission area.
